figures.finding: Guam had no formal processes for productions filming on the island when, in 2011, it announced plans for a film office and to explore incentives; no incentive enacted since was found.

value.status: film office and incentives proposed (2011); none found in force

figures.applies: Guam; 2011 report; status on 2026-11-01 not confirmed.

sources.said: Guam in the Western Pacific Ocean has announced plans to open a film office. At the moment there are no formal processes in place for production teams looking to film on the island … By exploring incentives and streamlining the permitting process, Guam can become a viable film location

figures.finding: Guam's law created a Guam Film Office in 2012 (Public Law 31-159) under the Guam Economic Development Authority, to set rules and fees and publish locations, permits and tax incentives, but by November 2016 it had been dormant for years; no incentive in force was found.
figures.applies: Guam; as reported by Pacific Island Times, 10 November 2016; current status not found (see blocker).

sources.said: the Guam Film Office, the body representing the government-side of business, has been dormant for years. Public Law 31-159 created the Guam Film Office in 2012, under the Guam Economic Development Authority.
